from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's 10-Q filing, raw amounts with units for normalization."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    total_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total assets numeric value")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale for assets: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total stockholders' equity numeric value (negative if deficit)")
    total_equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale for equity: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the balance sheet with the figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
